{{Conjecture|legends}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], this '''individual''' served as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commando]]. After the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|victory]] over the Empire and [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|establishment]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the commando lost his mind.<ref name="Countdown to Disaster">''{{JournalCite|7|Countdown to Disaster}}''</ref>

Having taken a job as a [[Chef/Legends|cook]] on a [[Hovertrain/Legends|magnetic lift train]] that was to take New Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Drextar Pym]] to a diplomatic conference, he hijacked the train in an elaborate attempt to assassinate the Senator, charging him with "crimes against the Empire". The attempt involved taking Pym's family hostage and blasting the family's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], as well as planting bombs on the train. The attempt was thwarted by a crew of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who were also on the train.<ref name="Countdown to Disaster" />
